claims.text: Helped organise the 9 June 2026 Capitol-steps press conference at which David Grusch described a continuum of alleged non-human life.
Asked how many alien species he was aware of, Grusch referenced four different alien species at the 9 June 2026 press conference.
'I certainly don't have the compendium it's a continuum from corporeal bipedal type life to what I would consider as sentient plasmoid life but there are several which the US government is aware of.'

edges.label: organised the platform for his June 2026 claims
